status: Executable artifact audit; human evaluation specified but not conducted
artifact_population: All five frozen V27 SQL/Cypher task pairs; none selected by favorable code length
automated_outcomes: Exact query characters and lexical tokens
Deterministic token edit counts for L1-to-L2, L2-to-L3, L3-to-L4 and L1-to-L5
Existing normalized tables and graph labels/relationships reused across tasks
Complete-output correctness checked by the storage benchmark

human_design.participants: Database practitioners; record prior SQL, Cypher and medication-domain experience
human_design.assignment: Counterbalance language order; assign different matched tasks per participant to reduce answer recall; randomize task order
human_design.materials: Equivalent schema diagrams, data dictionaries, task wording and frozen source inputs; identical access to documentation
comprehension_tasks: Identify exact source premises for a tariff witness
Distinguish repeated explanations from distinct candidate pairs
Explain why same-tariff peer reachability does not imply therapeutic interchangeability
change_tasks: Extend candidate retrieval to return source snapshots
Extend source-lineage retrieval to return rule/dictionary context
Add combined classification-path context with the common authorization premise
primary_outcomes: Elapsed time from task display to first fully correct submission
secondary_outcomes: Self-rated mental workload using a preselected scale
human_design.scoring: Task-specific expected complete outputs from the independent Python source oracle; comprehension answers scored using a frozen rubric by assessors blinded to representation
human_design.analysis: Report participant-level paired results and uncertainty; account for experience and task/order; determine sample size from a declared practically meaningful effect before recruitment

interpretation: Artifact size is implementation-specific and is not a surrogate for comprehension or authoring effort. No human advantage is claimed from this audit.
